policy: Collect exactly5 normal monsters and15 idle/move/attack clips. Preserve source pixels, palette, size and per-key timing. Composite attacks recover only exact nonwhite/non-guide pixels from latest lossless native review clips. Shared per-monster crop across3 states; integer zoom only. Source files and hashes preserved. No new poses, timing changes, combat data or Unity integration.

approval.scope: five normal monsters idle/move/attack and reviewed effects
